## Summary

Describe the change and the requirements it addresses.

## Validation

List the commands run and their results.

## AI-authored test checklist

- [ ] AI-authored tests identify a requirement ID in every test name.
- [ ] Expected values come from `requirements.md` or `openapi.yaml`.
- [ ] Integration tests use a real temporary SQLite database.
- [ ] Repository behavior is not mocked.
- [ ] Assertions cover observable output and stored state.
- [ ] Playwright tests use role-based locators and web-first assertions.
- [ ] Tests use no fixed waits and use fixed synthetic builders.
- [ ] The proposed test list was reviewed before many tests were generated.
- [ ] A human reviewed the AI-authored tests for correctness and scope.
